name: claude-chime
description: Shows a notification inside the exact VS Code window whose Claude Code session finished or needs permission. Companion to the claude-sounds Claude Code plugin.

claudeChime.enabled.description: Show a notification in this window when its Claude Code session finishes or needs permission.

enumDescriptions: Notify when Claude finishes responding and when it needs permission
Only when Claude is waiting for permission
claudeChime.notifyOn.description: Which Claude Code events raise a notification.

claudeChime.showPromptText.description: Include the answered prompt / requested command in the notification. Turn off to show only the project name (useful when screen-sharing).

claudeChime.autoDismissSeconds.description: Close the notification automatically after this many seconds. Set to 0 to keep it on screen until you dismiss it.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Claude Chime
walkthroughs.description: Sounds, project-named banners, and per-window toasts for Claude Code.

steps.title: Install the claude-sounds plugin
steps.description: Claude Chime displays signals emitted by the claude-sounds Claude Code plugin — install it once and restart open sessions.

steps.title: Optional: clickable macOS banners
steps.description: Install terminal-notifier and allow it in System Settings so OS banners focus the right window when clicked.
